thread:
jamal: Hey team — opened PR https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/inference/pull/712 that changes KV cache eviction to use a per-model LRU. Need quick review from runtime (alex), platform (maria) and infra (ron) for rollout gating. Also tagging security (sarah) for a fast look at the KMS usage. Planning to merge tomorrow morning if approvals + CI ✅.

alex: taking a look now. main risk I see is KV cache TTL corner case for short-lived sessions. I can comment inline with a repro.

maria: FYI platform: this touches the routing layer config flags we surfaced last quarter. I'll validate the flag toggles and rollout plan. should be able to review today.

ron: can you call out any infra-level config changes? if there are new env vars we need to sync with deploy pipelines.

jamal: no new env vars, just a small config struct bump. I'll paste diffs below.

jamal: ```diff
- cache: { size: 1024, ttl: 3600 }
+ cache: { size: 1024, ttl: 3600, per_model_lru: true }
```

ci-bot: CI started — unit tests, integration, and perf smoke. (jenkins #build-712)

alex: saw the repro, adding comment on edge eviction when sequence_len < KV.length. will propose a small guard: `if (kv_size == 0) return;`

jamal: thanks — I'll push a tiny fix in a follow-up commit in this PR.

maria: quick Q: does this change require a rollback plan if we see increased latency? what's the fallback?

jamal: yes — plan is to gate behind `runtime.feature.per_model_lru` flag + rollout via canary on 10% traffic for 4 hours, automated rollback to `false` on 95th-percentile latency > baseline+20ms. docs in PR description.

sarah: security quick check: KMS calls are unchanged, but double-checked that key IDs are read-only. good to me from secrets perspective. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: build failed — flaky integration test `kv_eviction_test` (timeout).

jamal: re-running flaky test locally, looks like a race where the test expects eviction immediately. I'll add a small wait/retry in the test.

alex: re-requesting review after test fix? ping me when pushed.

jamal: pushed fix `test: add retry to kv_eviction_test` (force-pushed).

ci-bot: CI started — build-712-retry

ron: merged agent: FYI infra has no objections. I checked deploy pipeline and the config bump doesn't need ops changes. good to go from infra side.

maria: reviewed and left one optional comment about metrics tagging. not blocking.

alex: approved — left one nit but not blocking.

sarah: approved from security.

ci-bot: CI passed — build-712-retry ✅

jamal: awesome, thanks all. I'll merge now and start the canary rollout at 06:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll post a short update in #incidents if anything pops. :rocket:

maria: thanks — will watch the perf dashboard.

ron: ping me if rollback needed, I'll stand by.

alex: great work.
